U.note: Distinctive terminal-style timer with solid timing and screen-reader support, but the ASCII bar, toggles, durations and two-step reset overbuild it and the small mono text is hard to read at a glance.

V.note: Clean, compact card with ring, mode tabs and tidy code, but no live region or timer role, only Space as a shortcut, and a tiny paused label.

W.note: Big bold time on a red mode-coloured screen with tabs, status line, auto-advance, chime and strong ARIA; slightly feature-heavy but very clear and mobile-friendly.

X.note: Polished dark card with ring and editable durations and compact correct code, but no ARIA or live announcements and the time is smaller than it could be.

Y.note: Warm, readable design with large time and a four-pomodoro roadmap; accessible and accurate, though the roadmap card, checkbox and notes add extra and the checkbox looks unstyled.

Z.note: Big, calm and focused with phase label, dots, status messages, timer role and good shortcuts; phone layout wraps buttons slightly awkwardly but it is the closest to simple and complete.
